Where a road runs off the map, it should end at a military blockade facing outward against the code-rot zombies, not lead into the next area. Use what exists: your cordon (337d2bd) has the fence, the Route 1 north/south and cross-street checkpoints and the Continuity troopers, and gonman drew the cordon sprites (task #37): trooper, red-and-white barrier, booth, floodlight. Audit College Park and any Act 1 maps the scaffolds connected to it. Every road out is either a manned blockade (no exit; a trooper or loudspeaker line when you walk up) or an exit the story opens later (like Route 1 north after act1.complete). Some blockades could hold off a few Code-rot-taken on the far side. Maps are in the world section now (gonman), so agree the split with gonman on the world board or general before you change map files.
